mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_chunk(doc_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, qdrant_point_id, metadata_json, created_at) values (#{docId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{tokenCount}, #{qdrantPointId}, #{metadataJson}, now())
mapper.select: select id, doc_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, qdrant_point_id, metadata_json, created_at from knowledge_chunk where doc_id = #{docId} order by chunk_index asc, id asc

select id, doc_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, qdrant_point_id, metadata_json, created_at from knowledge_chunk where id in
#{id}

select id, doc_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, qdrant_point_id, metadata_json, created_at from knowledge_chunk where qdrant_point_id in
#{pid}

select id, doc_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, qdrant_point_id, metadata_json, created_at from knowledge_chunk where ( match(content) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode) ) or content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by match(content) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode) desc, case when content like concat(#{keyword}, '%') then 3 else 0 end desc, case when content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') then 1 else 0 end desc, id desc limit #{limit}
